The following event took place in '''402 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warriors battle [[Thyrsus/Legends|Thyrsus]] [[Sun Guard]] on the planet [[Sintheti]] in a conflict that would last more than 3 years and become known as the [[Battle of Sintheti]].<ref name="GAW" /> Each group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] represented different claimants to the [[Horned Throne]].<ref name="EGTWACp2" />
